author: Polar_Express
body:
Folks,

Staff you guys are great! I know I talk a lot, and say a lot, but none of it is personal. From the Owner to the mods , I want to thank for for all that you do and all that we do not see. Minecraft is a game, and lots of you are putting mega time in Avicus when you could be doing something else.

Thanks again for all that you do.

:) + 1 Avicus /hugs
